+from fastapi import FastAPI, Header
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+@app.get("/")
+async def read_header(my_header: str = Header()):
+    return {"my_header": my_header}
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+def test_underscore_header():
+    # Default convert_underscores=True
+    # Should NOT accept my_header, should accept my-header
+    response = client.get("/", headers={"my_header": "value"})
+    print(f"Request with my_header: {response.json()}")
+    
+    response = client.get("/", headers={"my-header": "value"})
+    print(f"Request with my-header: {response.json()}")
+
+@app.get("/alias")
+async def read_alias(my_header: str = Header(alias="my_header")):
+    return {"my_header": my_header}
+
+def test_explicit_alias_underscore():
+    response = client.get("/alias", headers={"my_header": "value"})
+    print(f"Request with my_header (alias): {response.json()}")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_underscore_header()
+    test_explicit_alias_underscore()
